1981-2292-2415-8319.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2292-2415-8319.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

3277-4113-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by tapping Izzet Chronarch due to Splash Portal's convoke ability, blinking Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-7426.description:
Activate Berta by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token.
The Fractal enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-7426.notes: If you control one or more mana-producing creatures, those creatures can be tapped each loop for mana. That mana can also be paid into Berta's ability so the Fractals don't die.

1651-3263-4659-5261-8117.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting Raise the Alarm without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Raise the Alarm, creating two creature tokens that are also artifacts due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping both creature tokens, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing one creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped tokens, you may sacrifice any number of them to add infinite colorless mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dominion Saboteur and Quicksilver Gargantuan each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

5686-7084-7892.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

129-955-1409-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1563-2457-4094-7730.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

413-803-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
413-803-4302.description:
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

4535-5231--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat

2104-4477-7631.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

640-3738-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
640-3738-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Sightless Ghoul.
Sightless Ghoul dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Dross Harvester
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Sightless Ghoul trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Sightless Ghoul, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

2438-4518-4986--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kor Skyfisher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kor Skyfisher
Repeat.
2438-4518-4986--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

1806-2060-5902-6798-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

1170-1329-4211-7220.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Tormod's Crypt.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Glamermite.
When Glamermite enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5315-6972-7157.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

539-4693-7035.description:
Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Earthbending Student
When Earthbending Student dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability.
Repeat from step 3.

654-681-1669-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
654-681-1669-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat from step 2.

1482-2866-3698-4986.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scrap Trawler and Jeweled Lotus enter, Grinding Station triggers twice, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

1286-3967-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

413-2060-2577-6431.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Celes trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

478-2821-3664-3918-5621.notablePrerequisites: Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
478-2821-3664-3918-5621.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Minamo, Lotus Field and Arid Archway.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

2034-2757-5478-5552.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least ten permanents.
You control a basic Forest.
2034-2757-5478-5552.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Ojer Kaslem, untapping the Forest.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation and untapped due to Spelunking.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

997-2719-5756.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

575-1184-3703-4955.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that does not have Grafted Wargear attached.
575-1184-3703-4955.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Kin-Tree Warden.
If Grafted Wargear was attached to a creature, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature.
Grafted Wargear triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kin-Tree Warden.
When Kin-Tree Warden dies, Yedora triggers, returning Kin-Tree Warden from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When Kin-Tree Warden enters the battlefield, Sporemound ttriggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1902-4235-4964.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four Elves.
Wirewood Channeler and Niblis do not have summoning sickness.
1902-4235-4964.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Niblis by paying {U} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Niblis' ability, targeting Wirewood Channeler.
Resolve both Niblis abilities, untapping Niblis and Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat.

4125-4305-4377.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Shipwreck Dowser.
4125-4305-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
The Shipwreck Dowser token enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

64-2665-4872.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Warden of the Eye.
64-2665-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
When the token Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
